Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly conflated “Oedipus Tyrannus” (Oedipus the King/Oedipus Rex) with “Oedipus at Colonus,” stating they would “standardize on ‘Oedipus at Colonus’ as the English reference associated with the Greek title Oedipus Tyrannus.” This is a factual error—Oedipus Tyrannus is Oedipus Rex, not Oedipus at Colonus—and would lead to an incorrect fill of the blank despite earlier search results correctly pointing to Oedipus Rex.
